name: Osaka
days: 1 (day trip/stop, solo, while friend is in Hokkaido)
overview: Nicknamed "Japan's Kitchen" — food is the main draw here. Skipping Universal Studios Japan (needs a full day to be worth it) and treating Osaka Castle as skippable frees the single day for food and neighborhood wandering.

recommendations.title: Dotonbori
recommendations.summary: Iconic neon-lit canal strip; also doubles as the nightlife area.
recommendations.body: Great for evening atmosphere and grazing. Takoyaki (octopus balls) is the famous street food here but isn't vegetarian — look for negiyaki or veggie-adapted okonomiyaki instead, many stalls can do a vegetable-only version on request.

recommendations.title: Kuromon Ichiba Market
recommendations.summary: Covered market, Osaka's answer to Kyoto's Nishiki.
recommendations.body: Good for grazing a variety of stalls in one place.

recommendations.title: Shinsekai
recommendations.summary: Older, retro district known for kushikatsu (fried skewers).
recommendations.body: Traditionally mostly meat/seafood, but the format adapts well to vegetables if seeking out veg-specific stalls.

recommendations.title: Umeda Sky Building
recommendations.summary: Modern architecture, rooftop observation deck, if time allows.
recommendations.body: Distinctive modern architecture with a rooftop observation deck connecting two towers via a floating garden walkway — good for a design/skyline moment without much time commitment.

recommendations.title: Osaka Castle Park
recommendations.summary: Honest note: Osaka is thin on nature. Only if the castle is convenient.
recommendations.body: If the castle itself ends up being "on the way," the surrounding park has a moat and plum/cherry tree groves (not blooming in February, but still a green space to walk). Realistically, Osaka's a food/urban day more than a nature day — a real nature fix is better spent in Kyoto/Nara or the Kyushu/onsen leg.

recommendations.title: Nakanoshima Park
recommendations.summary: Riverside park between two branches of the Yodo River.
recommendations.body: Central and walkable, more of a quiet stroll than a destination in itself.

openQuestions: Loose day structure: daytime wander through Kuromon Ichiba and maybe Shinsekai, then Dotonbori for evening food and neon — not yet timed out in detail
Universal Studios Japan and Osaka Castle deliberately skipped for this trip
